integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action romantic drama, 16:9, five-second continuous shot. A cinematic live-action medium-wide shot in a rain-soaked university courtyard. Lin, an adult 21-year-old student with a black bob, a silver crescent hairclip on her left and a pale-blue cardigan, shelters her books. Chen, an adult 22-year-old student with wavy black hair and a forest-green varsity jacket, approaches holding a transparent umbrella. The camera slowly tracks toward their shy first glance.

overall_soundscape: Rainfall on stone and distant student footsteps.

non_diegetic_music: Sparse piano and a sustained string note.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action romantic drama, 16:9, five-second continuous shot. Under the same eave, Chen lifts his transparent umbrella over Lin. In a gentle close push-in, she steps beside him; their shoulders nearly touch and they exchange bashful smiles. Maintain their identical adult faces, clothing and silver crescent hairclip.

overall_soundscape: Rain on the canopy and soft clothing rustle.

non_diegetic_music: Piano and restrained plucked strings.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action romantic drama, 16:9, five-second continuous shot. A side-tracking camera follows the two adult students on a wet, tree-lined campus path. Chen tilts the clear umbrella toward Lin, wetting his own shoulder. Lin moves it back between them; their fingers briefly overlap on the handle. The camera settles on their hands.

overall_soundscape: Wet footsteps, light rain, distant bicycle wheels.

non_diegetic_music: Gentle piano arpeggios.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action romantic drama, 16:9, five-second continuous shot. In a warmly lit university library at dusk, Lin sits with her books. Chen approaches wearing the same forest-green jacket and sets the folded transparent umbrella beside her. A slow arc shot reveals their smiles as she slides out a chair for him. Keep her pale-blue cardigan and left crescent hairclip unchanged.

overall_soundscape: Pages turn, a chair slides, rain ticks on windows.

non_diegetic_music: Quiet piano and soft cello.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action romantic drama, 16:9, five-second continuous shot. At the same oak library table, Chen sketches a tiny umbrella on blank paper and slides it toward Lin. Their fingertips touch. The camera gently tilts from their hands to Lin's surprised soft laugh and Chen's smiling face. No readable text.

overall_soundscape: Pencil scratching, paper sliding, a quiet laugh.

non_diegetic_music: Bright piano notes and pizzicato strings.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action romantic drama, 16:9, five-second continuous shot. At blue hour after the rain, Lin and Chen emerge from the university library and walk along a tree-lined path. He carries the folded clear umbrella, she reaches for his free hand, and he gently interlaces their fingers. The camera slowly pulls back as they walk away beneath amber campus lights, joined hands visible until the final frame.

overall_soundscape: Dripping leaves, synchronized steps, light breeze.

non_diegetic_music: A resolving piano phrase and a fading warm string chord.
